Arno facade actually inspected: three deep open ground arches with paired square/Doric supports and lateral column bays, long rectangular upper gallery windows below overhanging tiled eaves, a middle level of closed arched/rectangular timber-framed glazing, pale plaster and gray stone pilasters/cornices, side towers/returned ranges, river embankment below. Independent Palazzo Vecchio tower visible behind; do not add it to the Uffizi model. No copied statues, inscriptions or private decorative graphics.
